mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs for three consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which raises uncertainty and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) above 101.0 for three consecutive months indicates a robust manufacturing recovery, which lowers supply-side uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 900 for three consecutive months signals a resilient consumer demand cycle, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in resilient periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 800 for three consecutive months signals a demand contraction, which raises uncertainty and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 consecutive months signals a disinflationary trend, lowering discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
